title: Popinjay Guild vs Alea Iacta
lede:
Alea Iacta beat the Popinjay Guild 32-6 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 4, holding the right objective in every round and the centre in three of the four.

The Guild never held ground against a charge: Ironthunder Vanguard 1's Round 2 charge sent four of its units back in disorder, and by Round 4 its Covenant Levies had walked away from a centre held by Caesar and a bodyguard on 3 HP.
result_line: Alea Iacta win 32-6 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Popinjay Guild (12 units, 248 RP) lined rows 12 and 13 around its HQ at (7,13): the Knight-Commander leading Silver Arrow Brethren 1 at 7,12, Silver Arrow Brethren 2 on the left at 3,12, the four Covenant Levies from 4,12 to 9,12, the Sniper Hesychasts at 6,12 and 10,12, the St. Barbara Field Guns at 4,13 and 11,12 and the Akritic Outriders at 9,13. Alea Iacta (7 units, 248 RP) set up on row 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): Caesar - Divus Imperator leading Ironthunder Vanguard 1 at 5,2, Ironthunder Vanguard 2 at 3,2, Legionnaire Squads 1 and 2 at 7,2 and 9,2, the Champion of Mars at 10,2 and the Speculatores at 11,2. Almost half of Alea Iacta's points sat in two characters (Caesar 75 RP, the Champion of Mars 45), and it had Priority with fewer units (8 to 13). The set-up was a race to row 7: Alea Iacta's Advances reached the centre and the right objective in the first move, while the Guild's walk stopped on rows 8 to 11.

1.title: Caesar's guard takes the centre and the arrows

feed.text: Primaries revealed: DEBT OF BLOOD for the Guild, IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS for Alea Iacta. Secondaries kept: MAN OF THE HOUR and STRONGPOINT. Alea Iacta chose Tactica Mercurii, spent 1 CP on Double Time for Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and gave the Speculatores a free Scouting Order; the Guild spent both its CP on Double Time for Silver Arrow Brethren 2.

Ironthunder Vanguard 1 with Caesar Advanced 5,2 to 6,7, into the centre's Objective Area, and the Champion of Mars rolled three 5s on the Movement Dice to reach 12,6 on the right objective. The Guild came up to rows 8 to 11: Silver Arrow Brethren 2 used the Double Time to reach 7,9, and the Akritic Outriders went to 8,8, the only Guild unit in an Objective Area.

Every Alea Iacta unit had no legal action. The Akritic Outriders' Spot & Mark made Caesar and Ironthunder Vanguard 1 MARKED, the Guild used the Providence Miracle, and Silver Arrow Brethren 1 (5, with Opening Loose), Silver Arrow Brethren 2 (1) and Covenant Levies 2 (1) took Ironthunder Vanguard 1 from 12 to 5: the fire aimed at Caesar landed on his bodyguard. Covenant Levies 1, 3 and 4 and both Sniper Hesychasts had no legal action.
Alea Iacta won the centre on OC 9 vs 3 (3 VP) and the right on OC 2 vs 0 (2 VP), and STRONGPOINT paid 1 VP and 1 CP. Pietas +4 (the log line; the round's snapshot reads 0). 0-6.

2.title: One charge moves four units; Silver Arrow Brethren 2 dies

feed.text: Alea Iacta spent 6 CP: Double Time on Ironthunder Vanguard 1 (1) and Troop Requisition (5), which placed a third Legionnaire Squad at 7,2. The Guild spent 2 CP on Double Time for Silver Arrow Brethren 2 again. DEBT OF BLOOD marked Ironthunder Vanguard 1. New secondaries: STRONGPOINT for the Guild, MAN OF THE HOUR for Alea Iacta.

Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and Caesar charged to 7,8, into the Knight-Commander, both Silver Arrow Brethren, Covenant Levies 2 and the Akritic Outriders. All four that tested failed their Fall Back test and broke away in disorder anyway, 1 True Damage each: Silver Arrow Brethren 2 to 5,9, Covenant Levies 2 to 8,10, Silver Arrow Brethren 1 with the Knight-Commander to 5,10 and the Outriders to 11,12. Ironthunder Vanguard 2 then charged to 4,8 into Silver Arrow Brethren 2. Overwatch: Sniper Hesychast 1 hit Legionnaire Squad 2 for 2 and killed its Decanus (LEADERLESS), St. Barbara Field Gun 2 missed, and Caesar put 2 into Covenant Levies 1 and PARALYZED it (the Fortitude Miracle is priced at 0.67 expected HP saved). Covenant Levies 3 walked 9,9 to 8,6, into the centre beside Caesar.

Ironthunder Vanguard 2 destroyed Silver Arrow Brethren 2 (5 and 4, 35 RP); Retribution let the Brethren swing back with five daggers for no hits, and the Vanguard took ground at 5,9. The Knight-Commander, with Exaltation, hit Ironthunder Vanguard 2 for 4 (12 to 8). St. Barbara Field Gun 2 used its once-a-game Blessing of St. Barbara and hit Legionnaire Squad 2 for 2; Caesar put 2 into Covenant Levies 3 and PARALYZED it; Covenant Levies 1 took Ironthunder Vanguard 1 to 4. The Speculatores' Auspex Scan SPOTTED the Akritic Outriders, and Legionnaire Squad 2 shot them for 5 (8 to 3). Ironthunder Vanguard 1 had nobody left to fight.
Covenant Levies 3 won the centre on OC 9 vs 7 (3 VP). Alea Iacta kept the right on OC 8 vs 0 (2 VP), and IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid 3 for its seven units out of its zone. 3-11.

3.title: The Guild falls back again, and the centre goes with it

feed.text: Benediction healed Silver Arrow Brethren 1 by 1. Alea Iacta spent 1 CP on Double Time for the new Legionnaire Squad and 1 CP on a Rally Cry through Caesar for Ironthunder Vanguard 1's Morale Test; the Vanguard stood at 7,8 in the enemy half, so COMMAND AUTHORITY, kept that phase, paid 2 VP at once. The Guild's 2 CP Double Time went to Silver Arrow Brethren 1. DEBT OF BLOOD marked Ironthunder Vanguard 1 again; the Guild kept PROBING STRIKE.

The Legionnaire Squad ran 5,4 to 6,8, beside the centre. Silver Arrow Brethren 1 and the Knight-Commander broke away from Ironthunder Vanguard 2 to 2,8, on the left objective, and Legionnaire Squad 1 charged them there. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and Caesar charged to 8,7 into Covenant Levies 3; the Levies passed Morale and broke away to 5,5, out of the centre. St. Barbara Field Gun 1 failed its test against Ironthunder Vanguard 2 and lost 2 HP falling back to 6,11. The Akritic Outriders rode to 13,8 for the right objective through the Champion of Mars' Overwatch, which missed.

Legionnaire Squad 1 hit Silver Arrow Brethren 1 for 4 (10 to 6), and the Knight-Commander's counterattack took 6 back (10 to 4). Go to Ground through Caesar held Covenant Levies 2's fire on the Legionnaire Squad to 1 damage, and the squad answered with 5 (19 to 14). St. Barbara Field Gun 2 hit the Champion of Mars for 6 (8 to 2). Legionnaire Squad 2 destroyed the Akritic Outriders (3). Caesar missed.

Alea Iacta held the centre on OC 17 vs 0 and the right on OC 8 vs 0 (5 VP), with IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS 2. The Knight-Commander and Silver Arrow Brethren 1 won the left on OC 6 vs 4 (2 VP) and completed STRONGPOINT (1 VP, 1 CP). Pietas reached Tier IV. 6-20.

4.title: The Levies walk home; Alea Iacta takes all three

feed.text: The Guild spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition, a fifth Covenant Levies at 8,12. Alea Iacta switched to Tactica Martis and spent 3 CP: Double Time for the Legionnaire Squad (1) and a Rally Cry through the HQ for the Champion of Mars, on 2 HP (2). DEBT OF BLOOD marked the Champion of Mars. PROBING STRIKE expired; the Guild kept DEEP REACH, Alea Iacta TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY.

The Legionnaire Squad used the Double Time to reach 2,6, on the left objective. Ironthunder Vanguard 2 charged to 5,10 into St. Barbara Field Gun 1 at 6,11, which broke away to 7,11; Ironthunder Vanguard 1's charge failed. The Guild pulled back: Covenant Levies 2 went 8,9 to 8,12, Covenant Levies 4 9,11 to 6,12 and the new Levies 8,12 to 5,12, while Covenant Levies 1 stopped at 7,9, a square outside the centre's area, and Covenant Levies 3 went further into the enemy half, to 2,4.

The Legionnaire Squad shot Covenant Levies 3 for 6 (18 to 12). The Knight-Commander destroyed Legionnaire Squad 1 (4 HP) and took ground at 2,7; Silver Arrow Brethren 1's daggers then did nothing to the Legionnaire Squad. Covenant Levies 1 took Ironthunder Vanguard 1 to 3 of 12. Go to Ground through Caesar covered Ironthunder Vanguard 2, which saved all five hits from Covenant Levies 4 while St. Barbara Field Gun 2 missed it. Sniper Hesychast 1 put 2 into Legionnaire Squad 2. Nothing attacked the marked Champion of Mars, on 2 HP at 12,7.

Alea Iacta took all three objectives: the centre on OC 7 vs 0 with Caesar and Ironthunder Vanguard 1, the left on OC 10 vs 7 with the Legionnaire Squad, the right on OC 6 vs 0 (7 VP); then IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS 2 and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3. 6-32, past the 30 VP target.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Alea Iacta took 19 of its 32 VP from objectives: the right in every round (8), the centre in Rounds 1, 3 and 4 (9) and the left in Round 4 (2). IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS added 7 (3, 2 and 2 in Rounds 2 to 4) and the secondaries 6 (STRONGPOINT 1, COMMAND AUTHORITY 2, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3). The Popinjay Guild scored 5 objective VP, the centre in Round 2 and the left in Round 3, and 1 from STRONGPOINT. DEBT OF BLOOD scored nothing: twice it marked Ironthunder Vanguard 1, which took every shot aimed at Caesar and still finished on 3 of 12 HP, and in Round 4 it marked the Champion of Mars, which nothing attacked. MAN OF THE HOUR (one unit destroying two) and DEEP REACH (the objective furthest from its HQ) were never in reach.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

For Alea Iacta, the Champion of Mars stood on the right objective in all four rounds for 5.8 VP (2 of its objective VP hinged on it) without making an attack of its own: its only shot was an Overwatch that missed. Caesar - Divus Imperator and Ironthunder Vanguard 1 took the centre in Round 1 and scored 6.2 and 6.9 VP. The Vanguard never made an attack in four rounds (inaction 4) because everything it charged broke away first, but its Round 2 charge moved four Guild units back and gave Ironthunder Vanguard 2 the kill on Silver Arrow Brethren 2. The Legionnaire Squad bought with Troop Requisition for 5 CP did 11 damage and scored 5.7 VP (28.6 per 100 RP), last of all the left objective. The Speculatores' Auspex Scan made Legionnaire Squad 2's 5 damage on the Akritic Outriders in Round 2 possible.

For the Guild, the Knight-Commander did the most damage on the table (14), destroyed Legionnaire Squad 1 and held the left objective in Round 3. Covenant Levies 3 scored the centre once (3.0 VP, 30 per 100 RP) and St. Barbara Field Gun 2 did 8 damage, 6 of it to the Champion of Mars. Sniper Hesychast 2 was idle all four rounds with no legal action, and the 27 Mana from PRAYING was never spent: no cast appears in the record, and the five Miracles cost nothing.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Guild could not do

It could not stand against a charge. Five of its eight Fall Back tests failed (seven of the eight needed a 6), the units broke away anyway and lost 6 HP doing it, and each time they left Alea Iacta's units standing on the ground they had been charged off. Nor did it contest the right objective: Alea Iacta held it on OC 0 from the Guild in every round, and the one unit sent, the Akritic Outriders, was destroyed on arrival in Round 3. The damage was close, 36 to 42 (6 of Alea Iacta's 42 is the True Damage of the Guild's own failed Fall Backs), but Alea Iacta destroyed 57 RP to 20.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 4, the centre: Caesar and Ironthunder Vanguard 1 held it on OC 7 with the Vanguard on 3 HP, and the Guild walked away from it: Covenant Levies 2 went from 8,9, one square from the area, back to 8,12, Covenant Levies 4 to 6,12, the new Levies to 5,12, and Covenant Levies 1 stopped at 7,9. Without the centre's 3 VP Alea Iacta would have stood on 29, short of the 30 VP target.
  • Round 4, DEBT OF BLOOD: the marked Champion of Mars was on 2 HP at 12,7 and no Guild unit attacked it; Sniper Hesychast 1, two squares away at 11,9, shot Legionnaire Squad 2 instead. The record does not show whether the Champion was a legal target; if it was, that was 3 VP left on the table.
  • Covenant Levies 3 fell back to 5,5 in Round 3 and walked on to 2,4 in Round 4, away from every objective, where it had no legal action and was shot for 6.
  • Alea Iacta's commands: the two Double Times on Ironthunder Vanguard 1 (Rounds 1 and 2), the Scouting Order and both Tactica picks bought nothing. Its other 10 CP did: the Troop Requisition, two Double Times that put the Legionnaire Squad on objectives, and two Rally Cries, the first of which paid COMMAND AUTHORITY.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated: of 13 stayed decisions, 10 (all eight risky holds and two helds) had no engager adjacent; they are the AI's charge-planning probes, not decisions. The real ones were Ironthunder Vanguard 2 holding against St. Barbara Field Gun 1 in Round 3, Silver Arrow Brethren 1 holding in Round 4, and Legionnaire Squad 1 staying on 4 HP in Round 4 (should have left), which the Knight-Commander then destroyed.

Mostly the army: Alea Iacta's TOUGH, elite charge squads against an army that fails its Fall Back tests and cannot hold an objective it is charged on. The Guild's AI made it worse by never fighting for the right flank and by walking away from a centre it could have contested in Round 4, which would have taken the battle to a fifth round but probably not changed who won it.

closing: Alea Iacta's elite squads charged, the Guild's units broke away and left them standing on the objectives, and the Champion of Mars held the right flank for four rounds without a fight. The Guild's arrows and Levies hurt Caesar's bodyguard but never killed it, and in the last round its Levies walked home.
